intercalated carboxylates in LDH interlayers can be photochemically hydrogen abstracted from by benzophenonecarbonyl ions to give their 1: 1 adducts with a high yield.
the photochemical hydrogen abstraction by BPC ions in the LDH interlayers was selective and distinctive from those of homogeneous systems.
the photochemical hydrogen abstraction from carboxylate anions by benzophenonecarbonyl anions in LDH interlayers is highly selective and distinctive.

the photochemical reactions in the interlayers of LDH.
the photochemical reactions of organic compounds intercalated in LDH interlayers.
the intercalation of aliphatic carboxesylate ions into LDH interlayers.

the intercalation of aliphatic carboxesylates into the interlayers of the LDHs is a useful tool for selective photochemical hydrogen abstraction reactions.
